67-press-proccessor.name: 67-press-proccessor
features: Design tab draws a straight tuck end box dieline from width, depth, height, glue tab and tuck flap inputs in inches.
Solid lines show cuts and dashed lines show folds on the flat view.
Artwork panel generates new box art or revises current art through the Anthropic API using a key saved only in the browser.
Roll tab lays boxes out on the press web with side margin, gap, spit plate and calibration square, and RUN animates the roll feeding.
Print flat supports Letter, Tabloid and A4 sheet sizes, and Download SVG saves the dieline.
Save design and Load design keep designs between visits.

access-terminal-admin.name: access-terminal-admin
features: Login screen takes a user and password and unlocks the dashboard against the Railway backend.
Dashboard lists the backend tables and loads rows for the picked table.
Columns sort when clicked and timestamps display as readable dates.
Session locks after idle time with an I am still here warning first, and Lock ends it right away.
Refresh reloads the current table.
access-terminal-admin.keepSeparate: Intentionally separate. The access terminal family is kept apart for experimentation and may grow. The merge layer skips it.

access-terminal-orange.name: access-terminal-orange
features: Kitchen hub themed sign in page with operator ID and access key fields.
Password strength meter scores the key as it is typed.
Enter Kitchen shows a result message after checking the password rules.
Live kitchen clock and a list of virtual brands display on the page.

aerophin-twin.name: aerophin-twin
features: Drawing set view shows twelve sheets for two coffee machines, a motorized column press in inches and a spring press brew head in millimeters.
Each part section ends with a bill of materials.
Part drawings view shows interactive 3D models that rotate and explode into parts.
Pause, reset view and stop rotation buttons control each 3D model.
Brew cycle animates the piston, knob twist and drip phases.

aliens-win.name: aliens-win
features: Ship select screen lets the player choose a vessel before Initiate Harvest starts the game.
Player flies a UFO and fires lasers at targets while enemy shots come back.
Waves advance with a banner, and HP and remaining count show on screen.
Obstacles, fire, humans and confetti effects draw on the canvas.
Game over screen shows with a Try Again button that restarts.

androids.name: androids
features: Four deploy modes: Vercel new frontend, Vercel update, Railway new backend, Railway update.
Form takes project name, download filename, commit message and environment variables, and rejects a filename named index or not ending in .html.
Page writes the full Termux command block for the picked mode and Copy block copies it.
Mark as used saves project names so reused names get flagged, and Clear list wipes them.
Nothing runs on the page itself.

ascend-pearl-ten.name: ascend-pearl-ten
features: Vertical platformer where the player climbs endless generated platforms, some of them moving.
Touch zones on screen steer and jump on a phone.
Coins, gems, gliders, rockets and powerups spawn during the climb.
Wind streaks, clouds and milestone banners appear as height increases.
Progress or best height saves in the browser.
